button.label: Button
button.useWhen: The user needs an explicit pressable action or submit control.
button.avoidWhen: The interaction is selection, toggling, dragging, or text entry.

checkbox.label: Checkbox
checkbox.useWhen: The user needs boolean selection or an indeterminate partial-selection state.
checkbox.avoidWhen: The interaction represents an immediate on/off setting; use Switch.

dialog.label: Dialog
dialog.useWhen: The UI needs a blocking centered modal for confirmation, alerts, or focused content.
dialog.avoidWhen: The content is a sliding panel or anchored floating surface; use Sheet or Popover.

draggable.label: Draggable
draggable.useWhen: The user needs direct manipulation, bounded dragging, or gesture-aware movement.
draggable.avoidWhen: The user needs to reorder a collection; use Sortable.

feed-list.label: FeedList
feed-list.useWhen: A virtualized feed needs refresh, pagination, or load-more semantics.
feed-list.avoidWhen: The collection only needs general virtualization; use List.

form.label: Form
form.useWhen: Multiple fields need coordinated value collection and submission.
form.avoidWhen: The task only needs one standalone input or selection control.

input.label: Input and TextArea
input.useWhen: The user needs text entry or keyboard-aware input layout behavior.

lazy-component.label: LazyComponent
lazy-component.useWhen: An expensive subtree should defer mounting until it approaches visibility.
lazy-component.avoidWhen: The content is lightweight or always visible.

list.label: List
list.useWhen: A repeated collection can grow large and needs virtualization.
list.avoidWhen: The content is small or structurally mixed; use ScrollView.

overlay.label: OverlayView
overlay.useWhen: Content must render above the normal view tree in a native overlay layer.
overlay.avoidWhen: A higher-level Dialog, Sheet, or Popover already matches the interaction.

popover.label: Popover
popover.useWhen: The user needs anchored floating content relative to a trigger or anchor.
popover.avoidWhen: The content should interrupt the full flow or slide from an edge; use Dialog or Sheet.

radio-group.label: RadioGroup
radio-group.useWhen: The user needs one selected value from a mutually exclusive option set.
radio-group.avoidWhen: Multiple options may be selected independently; use Checkbox.

scroll-view.label: ScrollView
scroll-view.useWhen: A bounded region with mixed or relatively small content needs scrolling.
scroll-view.avoidWhen: The content is a large repeated collection; use List or FeedList.

sheet.label: Sheet
sheet.useWhen: The UI needs a bottom sheet, top sheet, or side drawer with snap or drag behavior.
sheet.avoidWhen: The content is a centered blocking modal or an anchored floating surface.

slider.label: Slider
slider.useWhen: The user needs to select a numeric value along a continuous or stepped track.
slider.avoidWhen: The user should select from discrete text options; use a selection control.

sortable.label: Sortable
sortable.useWhen: The user needs drag-driven reordering of a collection.
sortable.avoidWhen: The interaction moves one item without collection reordering; use Draggable.

swipe-action.label: SwipeAction
swipe-action.useWhen: A row needs secondary actions revealed by a swipe gesture.
swipe-action.avoidWhen: The action should always remain visible.

swiper.label: Swiper
swiper.useWhen: The UI needs horizontal paging or carousel-style interactions.
swiper.avoidWhen: The content needs free scrolling without page snapping; use ScrollView.

switch.label: Switch
switch.useWhen: The UI needs an immediate binary on/off setting.
switch.avoidWhen: The interaction represents form selection or an indeterminate state; use Checkbox.

excludedComponents.presence: Internal composition primitive used by higher-level components.
